name: Altus Inschrijvingen
author: altusnl

sections.description:
Altus Inschrijvingen connects your WordPress site to the Altus Website API. Visitors can browse courses, filter available dates, and continue to the hosted Altus checkout to enroll.

Altus is a hosted operational training management platform for professional training providers. The service brings together customer management, classroom and driving-course planning, instructors, vehicles and locations, Code 95 and other compliance processes, communication, attendance and progress records, and invoicing. This plugin publishes a limited, public-facing view of course data from that operational platform; it is not a standalone storefront or the Altus service itself.

An active Altus environment with the Website API enabled is required.

Features

  • Bookable catalog with filters and pagination
  • Course overview and course detail pages
  • Availability, location, pricing, and booking deadline information
  • Enrollment through the hosted Altus checkout
  • Colors and branding from Altus or the active WordPress theme
  • Schema.org markup for courses and course dates
  • Temporary caching with fallback during short API outages

Shortcodes

  • [altus_catalog] displays the bookable catalog with filters
  • [altus_catalog product="CODE95" filters="no" limit="10"] displays a filtered catalog
  • [altus_products] displays the course overview
  • [altus_product code="CODE95"] displays a course with bookable dates

External service

This plugin retrieves course, location, availability, pricing, and branding data from the Altus environment configured by the site administrator. Search terms and filter values are sent to that environment as part of these API requests. The plugin does not send telemetry to the developer.

When a visitor selects “Inschrijven”, they leave the WordPress site and complete enrollment in the hosted Altus checkout. The enrollment becomes part of the same Altus environment used by the training provider for planning, compliance, communication, execution, and invoicing. From that point, the privacy policy and terms of the training provider and its Altus environment apply.

More information about Altus: https://altus.nl/
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin through Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate Altus Inschrijvingen.
  3. Go to Settings > Altus and enter the API URL for your Altus environment.
  4. Create pages for the catalog, course overview, and course details.
  5. Add the corresponding shortcodes and select these pages under Settings > Altus.
  6. Configure the return pages after checkout in Altus.
sections.faq:
Do I need an Altus account?

Yes. The plugin requires an Altus environment with the Website API enabled.

Where is enrollment completed?

The “Inschrijven” button opens the checkout for the configured Altus environment. Personal and payment details are not processed by this WordPress plugin.

Can I customize the appearance?

Yes. Colors and layouts can be configured under Settings > Altus. Templates can also be overridden from an altus-inschrijvingen/ directory in the active theme.

Can I disable the schema.org markup?

Yes. Disable it under Settings > Altus when another plugin already provides course markup.
